page.layout: One page of text in a single main column of verse-like Latin lines; marginal notes in the right margin beside the lines. Running head "ARABIA." at top with page number 215 at top right. Catchword/signature: none clearly printed at foot except the signature-like "O 2" at bottom centre-right.

main_text.p: Aliud quinetiam miraculu valde magnum obtigit illi: Semper fragrans aromatis, suauitur suboiet Arabia aromatis abundans. Vel thus, vel myrrham, vel bene odoratum calamum, Aut etiam diuinum maturescens thus, Vel casiam, reuera enim in terra soluit illa Iupiter ipsum Dionysum bene suto a femore: Proinde nato odorata nascebantur omnia.

Oues quinetiam tunc denss onerabantur velleribus Arabicæ oues. In pascuis, subitis item delabebantur aquis lacus. Volucres insuper aliunde non habitatis ab insulis Venerunt, folia ferentes non vitiatorum cinamomorum. At vero ille hinuli pallem in humeros extendit, Et hedera iucunda pulchras ornauit comas.
Ebrius autem vino implexos quaffauit thyrsos, Dionysius in Arabia educatus. Blandè ridens, & magnas hominibus illis diuitias superfudit.
Quare ad hunc vsque diem thure gloriantur arua, Montes autem auro, flumina autem alia ex parte aromatibus.
Ipsi autem incola valde pinguem populum habent, Felix Arabia auri & gemmarum ferax. Aureis vestibus gloriantes mollibus.
Verum enimuero primi quidè vltra decliuitate Libani Diuites habitant Nabatai. Nabataei pop.
Prope autem Chabasiique, & Agrei quos iuxta tellus Chablasij. Agrei pop. Chatramitica incolitur, & regione Persicca terra.
Caterum rubri latus habitant maris Minnaique, Sabaq, & vicini Cletabeni. Minnæi pop. Sabæ pop. Cletabeni populi. Tot quidem Arabiam ingentes gentes tenent.
Alia vero insuper & plurima : circunquaque enim est maxima.
Huius autem ad vlteriore regionem, sub flatu Zephyri, Sterile monticolarum aparet solum Eremborum, Qui vitam in petris suffossis posuerunt, Arabia infelix. Eremb i pop.

page.notes: The right-margin notes are partly blurred; "Eremborum" and "Ecembi" readings are doubtful. The running head and page number are partly faint. The first line begins with a decorated initial "A" that is partly obscured.
